items.text: Flame spread over a large solid sample was faster in microgravity than predicted from ground tests.
items.excerpt: Flame spread over the sample was faster than ground tests at the same airflow.

items.text: Droplet extinction diameter depends on oxygen concentration.
items.excerpt: Droplets extinguished at a diameter that depended on oxygen concentration.

items.text: Solid fuels can burn at lower oxygen levels in microgravity than the normal-gravity limit suggests.
items.excerpt: Spread was sustained at lower oxygen levels in microgravity than in normal gravity.

items.text: Gas jet flames blow off at lower velocities as pressure drops.
items.excerpt: Blow-off velocity fell as pressure was reduced.

items.text: Smoke particles are larger than the aerosols used to certify ground detectors.
items.excerpt: Median particle diameter was larger than typical ground-based smoke detector test aerosols.

items.text: Cool-flame extinction occurs at a larger droplet diameter than hot-flame extinction.
items.excerpt: Droplets extinguished at a diameter that depended on oxygen concentration.
